decisions.reason: Because it is far from the firm's maritime-focused solution path and the website shows no clear traction after two years, management would likely reallocate resources to better-fitting activities despite having some slack.

This service extends the firm's existing crewing capabilities into a related niche, and its continued presence on the website suggests performance is at least near aspiration for an adjacent offering.
The new maritime education programme shows early partner uptake with six institutions soon after launch and fits the firm's training assets and strategic expansion in integrated maritime services.

The emissions monitoring and compliance service has a clear documented success in meeting the FuelEU deadline for all relevant vessels and is closely aligned with regulatory demand and the firm's core offer.

The emissions compliance dashboard is tightly linked to the firm's digitalisation strategy and integrated into its ship management software, so organisational slack and strategic fit support continued market presence while results mature.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is also well aligned with the firm's software-based compliance offering, and although its standalone results are not yet shown, it is likely retained as part of a bundled solution.
